The son of banker Rodolfo Rinaldi, he founded brokerage and wealth-management businesses that joined larger banking groups. Based in Rome, he has also taught corporate finance at university.

long_biography.plain_text:
Alessandro Maria Rinaldi's early brokerage work included giving clients computer displays that updated their portfolios as market prices changed. Customers with computers in their offices could use telephone connections to follow the same information. Charts compared their investments with the market index, while the service earned its income from trading commissions.

He subsequently applied his financial experience to Garofalo Health Care's stock-market listing, which raised capital for acquisitions. Away from finance, competitive sailing has remained a substantial commitment. He began racing dinghies under coach Renzo Vongher and later helped create an offshore team that placed younger sailors aboard its leading race boat.
